title: Step 61-D variant selection, price and stock states
description: Productionize the Product Detail route and implement customer-facing variant selection using only canonical public variant price and availability truth from Step 61-B. Fetch typed GET /products/{slug}/variants through the existing server session bridge, select an appropriate default variant without inventing commercial truth, expose current/old price and low-stock/out-of-stock/stopped-sale states from backend fields, and keep rich media, specifications, related content, cart mutation and final hardening deferred to later Step 61 stages.

acceptance_criteria.description: The production /product/:slug route uses the canonical shared Product Detail loader and server-only customer-session bridge; the Step-61 placeholder is removed.
Variant data is fetched from typed GET /products/{slug}/variants and all selected price, sale-enabled, in-stock and available-quantity states come only from PublicVariantResponse fields.

Default variant selection prefers a sellable in-stock priced variant, then a sellable variant, then the first server-returned variant; this affects presentation only and does not mutate backend truth.
Low stock below 10 shows the authoritative available count; out-of-stock, stopped-sale and missing-price states are explicit. Toman remains integer/backend-authoritative.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront variant-price-stock:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/storefront static-quality

acceptance_criteria.description: No media interaction, specifications/related-content orchestration, cart mutation, backend/OpenAPI/database/dependency/current-state/design-contract mutation is introduced.

Canonical completion requires root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront quality, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before 61-E.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 61-D is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 61-E is blocked until protected transport, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release are green.
